intent: Review the source-bound Rust loss budget and its common-runner integration. Ensure incomplete thermal evidence stays indeterminate and retained source evidence cannot silently drift.

legacy_findings.title: Embedded document hashes are reported but not authenticated
legacy_findings.suggested_fix: Bind each embedded document to a reviewed expected SHA-256 constant (or an equivalent checked manifest), fail closed on mismatch, and add mutation coverage for every document.
legacy_findings.why_it_matters: The LOSS_SOURCE_BINDING pass currently proves only that files were embedded and hashed. Replacing a PDF changes the model's evidence while leaving the pass green; only one document hash is pinned by tests.
legacy_findings.evidence: documents_sha256 is computed at lines 179-180 without any comparison to expected digests; the sole asserted digest is 760800301.pdf in the test at line 208.

residual_risks: Adversarial reviewer did not reach a terminal outcome after bounded waits; no independent artifact was produced.
testing_gaps: Parent owns build and common-unit verification.
